set.body:
Introduce a typed condition and effect vocabulary in which scientific functionals are declared independently of design-matrix columns.

Compile those functionals to an axis-bound target T for each concrete regressor coding.

Acceptance: treatment and cell-means codings of the same declared effect have the same semantic effect identity and relation plan identity; compiler receipts record different coding and lowering details; changing the condition functional, units, or HRF target changes identity.

Raw X and T input remains supported as a narrower-capability path with parameterization bound into identity.
set.title: Phase 2A: Implement condition-vocabulary effect maps and coding-invariant identity
